description: A guide to the twelve-house tarot spread: how the wheel layout works, what each of the twelve positions covers, and how to read it without astrology.
lede: The twelve-house tarot spread places twelve cards in a ring, one for each area of life. It borrows astrology's structure but needs no knowledge of astrology.

layout.alt: Twelve small gold-edged tarot cards arranged in a ring under the heading A twelve-house tarot spread, numbered 1 to 12 anticlockwise from the left. A list in the centre names each house: 1 Self, 2 Money and values, 3 Communication, 4 Home and roots, 5 Creativity and play, 6 Daily routines, 7 Partnerships, 8 Shared resources and change, 9 Learning and travel, 10 Work and public life, 11 Friends and community, 12 Rest and the unseen.
layout.caption: Twelve cards form a wheel, each standing for one area of life. Read around the ring, then look at the whole circle.
